newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures ended higher across the board on Friday, as LME price gains overnight and the yen's weaker tone triggered active buying orders from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 3.7 yen to 5.7 yen higher, with the benchmark June 1998 contract up 5.1 yen at 203.1 yen per kg.
Heavy buying from individual investors supported the market, traders said. "There were buy orders from investors throughout the day," a brokerage house trader said.
The London Metal Exchange's three-month aluminium futures ended at $1,701 per tonne, up $4 from the previous day's close.
